answer: The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in lantern, expire in quill, and gale lists each expiry. An attacker running 189 aliases thus needs 76 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4124 identities would post 2806 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
